doc:
### PROPOSAL-18 — Receipt Paper - **slug**: `receipt` - **Vibe**: A thermal-printer roll — narrow mono columns, faint thermal-gray text, perforated edges, and everything slightly warm-smelling and ephemeral. - **Best for**: Earnings reports, order summaries, and ledger views — data as a printed transaction tape. Adjectives: ephemeral, tactile, transactional. - **Palette** (light theme, `is_dark: false`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#e8e4dc` | Counter-top backdrop behind the tape | | `--bg-surface` | `#faf7f0` | Thermal paper fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#ffffff` | Pristine paper (popovers) | | `--border-subtle` | `#e6e0d2` | Perforation hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#c9c2ae` | Paper edge / fold lines | | `--border-focus` | `#2a2a28` | Ink-black focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#2a2a28` | Thermal ink black | | `--text-secondary` | `#55534c` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#8a877c` | Faded thermal gray (aged print) | | `--color-action` | `#2a2a28` | Ink-black primary actions | | `--color-action-hover` | `#4a4a46` | Action hover (smeared ink) | | `--color-earnings` | `#1f6e43` | Green "PAID" stamp ink | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#175a36` | Earnings hover (deeper stamp) | | `--color-automation` | `#3a5a8c` | Blue rubber-stamp accents | | `--color-alert` | `#a8622a` | Rust "REFUND" stamp ink | | `--color-danger` | `#a8322a` | Red "VOID" stamp ink | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(42, 42, 40, 0.08)` | Ink bleed tint | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(31, 110, 67, 0.10)` | Green stamp tint | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(58, 90, 140, 0.10)` | Blue stamp tint | - **Typography**: Mono everything, like a dot-matrix head. Display and body: `"Courier Prime", "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` at 400-700. All-caps labels with wide `letter-spacing: 0.12em`. Totals in bold; amounts `tabular-nums` with right alignment. - **Radii & Borders**: None — the tape is a rectangle. Cards get sawtooth perforated top/bottom edges (CSS zigzag via `linear-gradient` triangles). Borders are dashed hairlines (perforation), 1px. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Rectangle, 1px solid ink border, uppercase mono label. Primary = ink-black fill with paper-white text; hover looks like double-strike (bolder, slight blur). Focus = 2px ink outline. - **Cards**: Paper strips with sawtooth edges top and bottom; content is left-aligned mono lines like `1x TIKTOK POST ......... $12.00`. A faint horizontal fold crease every ~80px. - **Badges/Status**: Rubber-stamp style: rotated (-6deg) bordered uppercase text like `PAID`, `PENDING`, `VOID` in stamp inks. No fills — stamp outline only. - **Tables**: Pure mono ledger: dotted-leader rows (`label ..... value`), no grid, totals row separated by a dashed 2px rule. Header = small caps. - **Forms/Inputs**: Underline-only fields on paper (no box); labels uppercase mono; focus = solid ink underline. Error = red `VOID`-style stamp next to the field. - **Loading**: The paper "feeds": content slides up one line at a time (mono rows appearing with a 60ms stagger, like printer output). - **Signature detail**: The sawtooth perforation + dotted leaders + rubber stamps — unmistakably a receipt, not a dashboard. - **Motion & Animation**: Printer-feed timing: rows appear top-down with 40-80ms stagger, slight translateY(-4px) -> 0; no fades to black — paper doesn't glow. Stamps land with a quick scale 1.15 -> 1 "thump". - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
TIKTOK POST.... $12.00
IG REEL........ $8.50
TOTAL ... $20.50
PAID
```
